meta.name: procurement-optimizer
meta.description: Cut software and services spend through seat-utilisation analysis, redundant-tool detection, and renewal-timing leverage. Use when auditing SaaS spend, preparing a renewal negotiation, or hunting a budget-reduction target.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析席位利用率,发现冗余工具,把握续约时机,削减软件开支
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为软件订阅费用操心,想在续约前算清账并砍掉不必要的开支。
copy.tagline_en: Cut software spending through seat utilization analysis and renewal leverage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage SaaS subscriptions and need to reduce costs before renewals.

howto.what: Claude 会盘点软件订阅:区分已分配和近30天实际登录的账号,对照分类基准找出闲置座位与重复工具,再按续约时间排出节省机会。关键数据缺失时,它会先提问而不是编造。
howto.when: 当你要求审计软件开支、准备续约谈判,或提出预算削减目标时,会触发。

say.text: 按近30天活跃账号做一次座位利用率分析,别用已分配数。
say.note: 会调用利用率分析脚本,按分类基准评估。

say.text: 把清单里功能重复的工具按迁移成本分组,挑出该砍的那个。
say.note: 会运行重叠检测,按迁移成本而非价格选保留方。

say.text: 按今天日期把节省机会按续约窗口排序,标出本周期锁死的部分。
say.note: 会运行机会排名,并列出 locked_this_cycle。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits software spend: separates assigned vs 30-day active seats, compares utilisation against category benchmarks, spots idle seats and duplicate tools, then ranks savings by renewal timing. It asks when key data is missing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are auditing SaaS spend, preparing a renewal negotiation, or hunting a budget-reduction target.

say_en.text: Run a seat utilisation analysis using only 30-day active seats, not assigned ones.
say_en.note: Calls the utilisation script and applies category benchmarks.

say_en.text: Group overlapping tools by displacement cost and tell me which one to cut.
say_en.note: Runs overlap detection and names a survivor.

say_en.text: As of today, rank savings opportunities by renewal window and flag locked savings.
say_en.note: Runs the ranker and shows locked_this_cycle.
